fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami’s economic downturn and banking credit, city commission politics and appointments, and disputes over municipal management. Coverage also addresses entertainment and labor concerns for local union musicians and city park bands, federal enforcement violence connected to rum-running in Biscayne Bay during Prohibition, and Miami Beach transportation policy affecting jitneys and private buses. Additional items include reports and columns on a fire in the Black neighborhood, civic incidents involving the American flag, local business advertisements, and sports notices including boxing and bicycle races, along with promotion of a state bathing beauty revue.
